name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters National Tournament attendance card
notes: 400 copies of a single-card promo ("Kanan the Swordmistress") given to attendees of the first Duel Monsters National Tournament (held February 1-21, 1999; card distributed at the February 21 final). This is the earliest dated OCG distribution certified in this ledger, predating Vol.1 by 12 days. "Kanan the Swordmistress" is OCG-only (never released in the TCG) and has no other pre-cutoff source in this ledger, so this record is its sole route into the certified pool. Date and identity independently re-verified 2026-08 directly against Konami's own card-level print-history for this card (passcode 12829151, cid 4358): its earliest and only 1999 printing entry is this product, dated 1999-02-21. \n\nCORRECTION NOTE (2026-08 recertification): an earlier pass also authored a sibling product, "yu-gi-oh-duel-monsters-national-tournament-prize-cards", claiming three further cards ("Millennium Shield", "Megasonic Eye", "Yamadron") were physically distributed on this same date as a "qualifying tier" of prizes. That claim was FALSE and the product has been deleted. Root cause: Yugipedia's "...National Tournament prize cards" page lists these results in a two-column table ("Physical card" / "Video game card") by placement tier; for the Qualifying tier, only the Video game card cell is populated (Kanan the Swordmistress, Millennium Shield, Megasonic Eye, Yamadron), each linking to a "(DM1)"-suffixed Yugipedia page describing a hidden/unlockable reward inside the Game Boy title Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters (released 1998-12-16, itself Non-OCG) - these pages use a distinct `{{DM1 card}}` template with a `prize_condition` field and no passcode field at all, unlike genuine OCG cards' `{{CardTable2}}`. Kanan alone is ALSO physically real, but via this wholly separate attendance-card distribution documented here - not via that table row. Konami's official database has no product id for a February "prize cards" release, and Millennium Shield/Megasonic Eye/Yamadron's own individual Konami print-history records show their earliest OCG printing as 1999-06-01 (Limited Edition: Yugi Pack / Joey Pack, already certified elsewhere in this ledger), with nothing earlier. Deleting the false product does not remove these 3 cards from the certified pool: they remain correctly available via their genuine June 1999 release.
